programme.title: G'wed
programme.desc: The first episode of a comedy series providing an honest, uplifting and heart-warming portrayal of the lives of working-class teenagers from Liverpool while tackling issues with a refreshing humour. Recently-orphaned Southerner Christopher goes to live with his nan on a council estate in Liverpool - there he forms an unlikely unholy alliance with working-class Reece. On the verge of being expelled, Reece convinces his school's headmaster to give him one last chance and allow him to mentor Christopher to prove that he can positively contribute to the school - despite their differences, a friendship develops between the pair until Christopher throws Reece under the bus in order to impress a girl. An angry Reece can't resist getting his revenge on Christopher, but will this ruin his chances of remaining at the school? Meanwhile, Aimee reluctantly gives her boyfriend Lewis a gift to help with his sexual needs, but she soon learns that he has been cheating on her and seeks revenge...

programme.title: The Only Way is Essex
programme.desc: Pete is taking his title of Love Guru seriously and is whisking everyone away to a singles' retreat - it's perfect timing for his partner in crime Lockie to return, but will the singles be opening up their hearts and minds with workshops, insightful classes and practical tips on offer, or will the mix of different personalities lead to explosive encounters? Elsewhere, new beginnings are on the horizon for Sims - Chloe is not only moving house, but also off on an exciting work trip to Paris for Fashion Week. Will this be the start of a worldwide make-up career for Sims, and will this big break make Sims realise that life really is beginning at 40? Meanwhile, Dan and Amber are in the glow of new parenthood with puppy Oliver, but they have yet to pass the ultimate test - their parents meeting each other - and there are new revelations even though Dani managed to shut down rumours about her and Gatsby's relationship. Is there unresolved history between Gatsby and Chloe Brockett?

programme.title: Supercar

programme.desc: 1957. Thriller. Directed by Peter Graham Scott. Stars Honor Blackman, Griffith Jones & Ursula Howells. When a wealthy banker's wife is found murdered, the police find many suspects with a motive. [S]

programme.title: The Breaking Point
programme.desc: 1961. The nephew of a printer gets involved with foreign spies' intent on making counterfeit money. Stars Peter Reynolds & Dermot Walsh. [S]

programme.title: The Spaniard's Curse
programme.desc: 1958. Thriller. Director: Ralph Kemplen. Stars Tony Wright, Lee Patterson, Michael Hordern & Susan Beaumont. A man of Spanish heritage is convicted of murder & places a curse on the judge & jury. [S]

programme.title: Look At Life Let's Go Dancing

programme.title: Assignment K

programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: Emily Atack and Danny Dyer host a strategic reality quiz packed full of drama and deception. The endgame detonates! Picking up after the cash offer, one shaken player chooses certainty over risk and exits, leaving the remaining contestants to face the most dangerous phase of the game yet. A lavish operatic final challenge delivers spectacle and consequence, granting the winner the power to eliminate a rival outright. A long-standing moral compass finally slips, resulting in a bold, emotionally-charged decision that shocks the house. The series concludes with a tense head-to-head built on bluff rather than knowledge. In a final reversal, the most underestimated player outmanoeuvres their opponent to win - proving that in this game, adaptability beats intelligence every time.

programme.title: TikTok: Murder Gone Viral
programme.desc: With exclusive access to the victims' families, friends and the police, this documentary strand explores extraordinary true crime cases linked to the world's fastest-growing social media platform. TikTok influencer Alexis Sharkey seemed to have the perfect life - she regularly posted videos to her 80,000 followers, but all this came to a sudden end when she disappeared in November 2020. Her parents and friends became increasingly worried and reported her missing - on the 28th of November, 2020, a rubbish truck driver spotted a naked body dumped in the gutter of a side road in Houston. The police confirmed that it was Alexis and revealed that the 26-year-old had been strangled to death - detectives then began a murder investigation and news of the popular influencer's death went viral on TikTok. Just two weeks after Alexis was found dead, her husband Tom also disappeared - however, two of the influencer's closest friends revealed that Alexis had said that she was being abused by him.
